title: Repair fixed-column comment-aware COPY preprocessing
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of source_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: The exact pinned COSGN00C Apache-2.0 line containing 'copy of' is a fixed-format comment and never becomes a COPY directive.
Columns 1-6 and 73 onward are non-semantic, column-7 comment indicators are explicit, and column-7 hyphen continuations join reached literals without losing exact decoded source bytes.
Semantic output and every retained/expanded byte range carry repository-relative source origins; each removed COPY directive retains exact origin spans.
All reached simple, quoted, multiline, and multi-pseudotext COPY REPLACING forms expand deterministically across all 44 pinned programs.

The nine external compatibility placeholders are comment-only conformance inputs; they provide no constants, layouts, success behavior, or production fallback and are replaced by owned contracts in CD-003.
Missing, circular, malformed, depth-limited, continuation-invalid, token-limited, and expansion-size-limited inputs remain explicit failures.
